sources.title: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: The Qwen3‑4B‑Instruct‑2507 is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual instruct language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics. Unlike the base Qwen3‑4B, this variant has only instruct training without thinking mode support.
